Octan Corp Relocation Benefits v1.5
Effective 2026-04-10

Benefits Overview

Temporary housing is provided. Up to 45 days, EUR 3,000 monthly cap.

Tax equalization: Octan covers tax assistance through a third-party advisor.

Settling-in allowance: USD 2,000 lump sum.

Language training: Up to 40 hours of language lessons in the host country.

Visa support: Immigration paperwork is handled by Octan's mobility partner.

(Note: This policy does not specify eligibility bands or assignment types.)
